A '''battle''' took place on the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and marked the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] second return to the planet during the war. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]], along with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were sent to stop the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invasion, led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] warlord introduced a new weapon, able to jam all [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] communications. With the jamming in place, the Jedi and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] faced a difficult battle but were eventually victorious.

==Prelude==
The ''Indomitable'' Battle Group drifted in space near Kothlis awaiting orders. Comm Officer Lt. [[Avrey]] received a [[Priority Alpha]] communication from [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The Admiral and Jedi went over to the [[Battle Operations Room]] to watch. The recording of the diminutive Jedi Master informed those present that General Grievous was moving his fleet towards Kothlis and ordered them to intercept before the Bothan Spynet was eliminated. Yoda also authorized them to call for reinforcements. The conservative Republic Admiral had grave doubts about the upcoming battle, but Skywalker convinced him it was necessary. Upon returning to the bridge, the Admiral called his fleet to battle stations and gave the order to [[Hyperspace/Legends|jump]] to Kothlis. With a half-hour trip, Kenobi and Skywalker went to meditate while the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] Ahsoka Tano went to mobilize the ground troops. She met them in the mess hall, and after interacting with them for a few minutes, ordered the clones to start preparing for battle.

When the Republic forces reverted to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], they found Grievous' fleet already waiting. To make matters worse, the Separatist forces introduced a powerful jamming system, able to completely close down Republic communications. Lt. Avrey informed the leaders she could work a way around the jamming using ancient but still usable technology. After an hour of waiting for a fix, Skywalker led the space forces to battle the opposing fleet while the ground forces were inserted into the atmosphere. The fighters were entirely without a way to organize their counter-strike and relied on split-second timing for the assault.

==The battle==
While Skywalker destroyed numerous droid starfighters, his Padawan assisted Kenobi and the clones while they engaged the droid infantry. Skywalker's flying prevented a number of Clone pilot losses. After taking numerous losses, the Republic drove off the Separatist fleet. Many Bothans had gotten caught in the cross-fire, but the Bothan Spynet survived relatively intact, meaning the primary objective of the battle was fulfilled. Obi-Wan Kenobi received shrapnel from [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and Ahsoka Tano was knocked unconscious. Lt. Avrey cleared communications and called the ''[[Coryx Moth]]'' to assist. After the battle, Skywalker landed near the battle scene while [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] eliminated the remaining Vulture droids. The Jedi General helped Clone [[Medic/Legends|medics]] heal the wounded and called for an evacuation of his former master and apprentice. When he arrived back unto the ''Indomitable,'' he was informed it had received damage and would be in space-dock for weeks. The Jedi were sent back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] on the ''[[Pioneer]]'' while the wounded were shipped to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] to recuperate.

==Behind the scenes==
[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 29|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 29]] seemingly refers to this battle while placing it between the events of ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''; however, those two works are instead dated to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' and [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 23|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 23]] instead. Thus, the mentioned in Part 29 may instead refer to [[Battle over Kothlis|the battle]] portrayed in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]''.<ref name="Kothlis-FactFile">{{FactFile2014|29|GRI 5-8|General Grievous}} states that [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] attempted to capture the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] between the [[battle of JanFathal]] (from ''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]'') and the [[battle of Nexus Ortai]] (from ''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]''). Although Grievous was involved in the later [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on Kothlis as depicted in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' and {{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}} date ''No Prisoners'' and ''Shipyards of Doom'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] respectively, and ''The Essential Reader's Companion'' instead dates ''Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth'' to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Thus, ''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 29 must instead be referring to the battle from ''[[The Clone Wars: The Wind Raiders of Taloraan]]'', and the battle must occur in 22 BBY as well.</ref> However, this is contradicted by the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide|official episode guide]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which places the events of ''The Wind Raiders of Taloraan'' in 21 BBY.<ref name="TCW-EG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
